verdict.rationale: Superhuman's Ask AI lets users ask natural-language questions of their inbox ("where is the q2 offsite", "when is my flight") and get succinct answers without remembering senders or keywords. The official Mail MCP also connects inbox and calendar to Claude/ChatGPT for cross-inbox and calendar workflows, including summarizing threads and checking follow-up status. Missing for 10: no evidence that answers are grounded with source citations or links to messages, no explicit evidence that Ask AI itself queries the calendar or handles "what's outstanding" questions, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
